scripts.setup: uv sync && npm install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "uv run python web/main.py" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" --names "API,UI" --prefix-colors "blue,green" --kill-others
scripts.start:localhost: npm run check:start && cd web && uv run python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
